title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
authors: Bole Ma; Jan Eitzinger; Harald Köstler
affiliations: Erlangen National High Performance Computing Center
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Policy-driven edits in agentic conversations remove or replace earlier tool outputs and shift downstream content, violating the append-only assumption of prefix caching. Existing serving stacks therefore re-prefill the changed suffix because they lack a policy-facing primitive that preserves valid cached work across semantic edits.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 對話中的 policy-driven edit 會移除或替換先前的 tool output，並改變後續內容的位置，因而破壞 prefix caching 的 append-only 假設。既有 serving stack 缺乏可在語意編輯後保留有效 cached work 的 policy-facing primitive，因此必須對變更後的 suffix 重新執行 prefill。

key_innovation.en: Leyline exposes a declarative (span, replacement) directive with AMORTIZE and FORGET modes. Its SGLang integration preserves the unchanged radix prefix and, for AMORTIZE edits, freshly prefills the replacement while applying a closed-form RoPE delta-rotation to downstream MLA K_pe slots instead of recomputing the unchanged suffix.
key_innovation.zh: Leyline 提供具 AMORTIZE 與 FORGET mode 的宣告式 (span, replacement) directive。其 SGLang 整合會保留未變動的 radix prefix；對 AMORTIZE edit，系統僅對 replacement 執行 fresh prefill，並以封閉式 RoPE delta-rotation 校正後續 MLA K_pe slot，而不重算未變動的 suffix。

baselines_compared: SGLang RadixCache, Cache-off, Full re-prefill, keep_all policy

key_improvements.en: The splice path raises replay cache-hit rate by +11.2 percentage points over standard RadixCache and reduces p50 end-to-end latency by up to 241 ms (4.4%) at concurrency 8. Separately, a truncation policy raises debug-gym solve rate by +14.3 percentage points, from 31.2% to 45.5%.
key_improvements.zh: Splice path 相較標準 RadixCache 將 replay cache-hit rate 提升 +11.2 percentage points，並於 concurrency 8 時將 p50 端到端 latency 最多降低 241 ms（4.4%）。此外，truncation policy 將 debug-gym solve rate 提升 +14.3 percentage points，由 31.2% 增至 45.5%。

gpu_count: 1-4x GPUs per configuration (4x H200 TP=4; 2x H100; 1x H200; 1x H100)

reuse_metric.en: Replay cache-hit rate is 60.8% versus 49.6% for standard RadixCache (+11.2 percentage points) at every tested concurrency; first-token agreement with RadixCache ranges from 94.5% to 100% across the batch-scaling sweep.
reuse_metric.zh: 在所有測試的 concurrency 下，replay cache-hit rate 皆為 60.8%，相較標準 RadixCache 的 49.6% 提升 +11.2 percentage points；batch-scaling sweep 中與 RadixCache 的 first-token agreement 為 94.5% 至 100%。
